facts.text: The actuator plugin declares Volts as its controller units
get_NIDAQ_devices returns the system device names reported by DAQmxGetSysDevNames
getAOMaxRate reads the maximum analog output rate from the device
getAIMaxRate reads the maximum single-channel analog input rate from the device
getTriggeringSources lists PFI terminals of digital-triggering devices and analog input channels of analog-triggering devices
writeAnalog stores the written array in write_buffer and writes a single sample with WriteAnalogScalarF64 when the array holds one value
get_last_write returns the last element of write_buffer for a scalar write
get_last_write_index returns the task's current write position, or -1 when no task exists
getAOVoltageRange reads the device's analog output voltage ranges and uses a constant only when the query fails
stop stops the NI task and start starts it
The scanner documentation states that one cannot read the current voltage applied at an analog output
The upstream documentation describes an analog output driving a piezoelectric scanner through an amplifier

operator_required.reason: the clone reads the output voltage range from the device at run time and uses a constant only when that query fails, so no text file states the window of the installed card; the site supplies the output window of its hardware
